correctness.rationale: The directive prefixes reconstruct exactly to the stated length-36 palindrome. The seven displayed factors give a transparent lower bound: three eligible-position sets inside positions 0–14 have empty common intersection and require at least two points, one factor forces a point in the disjoint range 15–20, and three sets inside 21–35 likewise require at least two, totaling five. Independent replay enumerated all 500 distinct nonempty factors, verified the attractor {3,7,15,21,25}, and exhaustively rejected all 58,905 four-position sets.
residual_risks: The theorem is a single explicit counterexample and does not bound all later prefix attractor sizes.
